what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Zimbabwe, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7612 refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in Zimbabwe, 0.6% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996 to 2025, with M23 among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025 and over Katanga territory in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 31 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 8919, at the end of 2022.
The main years of displacement in the data include 2013 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Zimbabwe.
These are year-end totals for Zimbabwe only, reported to UNHCR.
